title: Delete Part on a part on a work order shows why and does nothing
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DELWO-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15442) has a line, {Line-1} (for example "Replace - Brake pot"), holding {Part-A} picked from stock.
custom_steps:
1. Type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Hover over Delete Part.
  4. Click Delete Part.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: a tooltip reads "Please delete related work order parts first."
  • Step 4: nothing happens; the window stays open.
  • Step 6: {Part-A} is still listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S13-R27, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (The part as it stands), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan §6 Phase 6 frontend (Delete trap). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
